text:
kari: CSM alerted me — SafeMed disputed INV-2026-44567. They claim we should've prorated the Private Deployment platform fee during a 45-day pilot where 60% capacity was moved to Dedicated. Renewal at risk.
tony: paste invoice lines pls
kari: PDF excerpt:
```
INV-2026-44567
Period: 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $64,500
Support: Standard (annual) - $7,200
Pilot: 45-day Dedicated pilot 2026-11-10 to 2026-12-24 (OPS-7202) - 60% capacity
Committed GPU true-up - 210 hrs @ $13.50/hr = $2,835
```
indra: contract read: platform fee annual non-proratable unless amendment. support proration allowed. any signed amendment?
marta: sales thread shows verbal concession: AE wrote "okay to credit pilot" in slack on 2026-11-09 but no signed amendment in SFDC. ops confirms OPS-7202 executed and notes 60% shift for 45 days.
tony: customer asks for two things: (1) support proration back to Standard for 9/1-11/09 then Standard->Premium timeline (no support dispute right now), (2) pro-rata platform credit for 60% * 45/365 of annual fee or a billing memo while legal reviews.
indra: quick calcs: platform pilot credit = 64,500 * 0.6 * 45/365 = $5,336.44. this is >$5k so needs Head of Revenue waiver per policy. support proration small if any.
kari: customer requested immediate account-level credit to avoid chargeback, and asked for written confirmation by EOD 2026-12-01.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-2100 created for support proration $1,000. Reference INV-2026-44567. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
tony: propose: post support proration credit now; create provisional, non-posting credit memo for platform pilot labeled "pending legal + Head of Revenue approval"; set invoice hold for 21 days.
legal: we need written sales authorization or Head of Revenue approval to process >$5k credit. AE slack note is weak evidence. If Head of Revenue approves, record SAR and one-time concession.
indra: ops to attach OPS-7202 logs to the invoice and confirm which GPU hours were tests.
marta: ops attached OPS-7202 and flagged 30 hrs as "test". if excluded, GPU overage reduces by 30 * 13.5 = $405.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-2101 created for GPU adjustment $405. Reference INV-2026-44567. Status: pending ops verification.
kari: action items: (1) revenue-ops approve CM-2026-2100 (@tony), (2) legal+Head of Revenue review pilot platform credit $5,336.44 (@legal + @indra), (3) ops finalize GPU test-hour verification and attach logs (@marta), (4) collections: place a 21-day hold on INV-2026-44567 (@tony).
tony: I'll set hold and message AR. I'll also draft a customer note confirming support credit and that platform credit is under expedited review.
kari: customer fragile — please prioritize. :pray:
